subject: Approval playbook & signer checklist for executive hires (Q3 signoff)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@talentbridge.com>, CompOps <comp-ops@payroll.example.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Approval playbook & signer checklist for executive hires (Q3 signoff)

Team —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. I attached the first draft of the "Executive Hiring Playbook" and an operational signer checklist. The ask: before we present to the CEO / CFO next Tuesday, I need signoff on two things by EOD Tuesday (May 11):

1) The compensation band floor/ceiling for VP+ (document page 6) — Laura, please confirm these figures align with comp ops and legal.
2) The signer matrix (who can approve offers, who needs CFO vs CEO, and delegated thresholds). Marissa, can you confirm the delegated signers and escalation path?

Quick context: we have three expected VP-level hires (Product, Infra, and Sales Ops) in Q3. We are proposing a combined headcount commitment of 3 FTEs with budget holdbacks tied to OKR milestones (outlined in the playbook). This is a firm ask from the business to get the formal authorization path and offer signers in place before candidate outreach.

Attachments: exec_hc_playbook_v1.pdf, signer_checklist_v2.xlsx

Please reply with: APPROVED / APPROVED W/ COMMENT / NEEDS CHANGE and any short notes. If no reply by EOD Tue, I'll assume approval from non-responders and escalate any open items to the CFO.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of People Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Park <emily@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval playbook & signer checklist for executive hires (Q3 signoff)

Logan —

APPROVED W/ COMMENT. Overall good. A couple small operational changes:

- Signer thresholds: I recommend we set the VP offer threshold requiring CFO signoff at total target comp > $450k rather than $400k. That gives us better runway on comp uplift without pulling the CEO into routine VP offers.
- Escalation timing: change 48h for candidate acceptance window to 72h when a candidate requests time due to relocation or notice periods — avoids needing on-the-fly approvals.

I updated the attached signer_checklist_v2.xlsx (tab: signer_matrix) with the threshold change. If Aditya and Laura are good with the threshold number and the 72h change, I can present this on Tues.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
SVP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, CompOps <comp-ops@payroll.example.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval playbook & signer checklist for executive hires (Q3 signoff)

Marissa / Logan —

APPROVED. Finance is okay moving the CFO threshold to $450k. Two notes from my side:

- Budget: the three VPs fit inside the Q3 hiring envelope if we stagger offers (one in July, two in August) and use the proposed holdback (20% of hire budget tied to post-90-day milestone). Please include the hiring dates in the playbook executive summary; that helps forecasting.
- Deal_id: for traceability, can we add an internal deal tag to each offer packet (e.g., DEAL-HC-Q3-2027) and push it into the ATS and HubSpot? That will make it easier for Finance and CS to trace ramping revenue assumptions.

I'll sync with CompOps on the payroll integration for comp bands; they may need a day to confirm specific payroll codes.

-Aditya
VP, Finance Planning & Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@talentbridge.com>, CompOps <comp-ops@payroll.example.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval playbook & signer checklist for executive hires (Q3 signoff)

Logan / team —

APPROVED. Comp bands checked against both market comp table and internal precedents. Notes:

- VP band (target total comp): $320k — $525k. The upper quartile exercise supports the $525k ceiling for exceptional candidates.
- Legal: included a standard relocation clause and a 90-day contingent bonus schedule; nothing material to flag.
- Payroll: CompOps will map the bands to payroll codes; CC'd on this thread (they will confirm by EOD Wed).

Emily — can TalentBridge confirm candidate sourcing timelines? We want first slate in mid-July.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations & Employment Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Park <emily@talentbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval playbook & signer checklist for executive hires (Q3 signoff)

Hi all —

Thanks for the clarity. TalentBridge CONFIRMS: first candidate slate ready week of July 12, interview loop scheduled week of July 19, and offer targeting late July for the lead Product VP. We will prioritize internal-external mix per the playbook and share source-of-hire tracking.

Deliverables we will post to the shared folder by Friday: candidate slate, initial scorecards, and projected compensation ranges for each candidate (so you can cross-check with the band table).

Emily Park
Director, Executive Search
TalentBridge Recruiting
